description.value: Howard Johnson by Wyndham is a national chain hotel situated along Alaska Road North in Fort St. John, a key hub for cyclists traveling the Alaska Highway corridor. The two-storey property offers standard hotel accommodations under the Wyndham Rewards loyalty program. For touring cyclists passing through northeastern BC, it represents a reliable overnight stop in an otherwise remote stretch of highway.
